resolution: Phase 5a of the UV→texture pipeline (PLAYBOOK Part 5): fixed the UV preview at the data layer so it behaves like Blockbench — stored, stable UVs instead of a live re-projection. EditMeshFace.uv is now NORMALIZED [0,1] per-corner STORED data (V2[]). New unwrap(m) box-projects + shelf-packs ONCE and writes face.uv; cuboid()/cylinder() call it at mint so a fresh part is already unwrapped; cutMeshByPlane interpolates new-corner UVs along the cut (so a cut subdivides within the parent island and shared cut verts drop boundary notches on neighbors for free); splitQuad carries UVs; editMeshToGeometry now passes real per-corner UVs through for a future textured mode. Geometry edits (translateVerts/scaleVerts, the gizmo) never touch uv, so pulling an edge/vertex no longer mutates the atlas — the headline bug the user demonstrated. UVPanel.tsx now reads storedUVLayout(mesh, texSize=STUDIO.unitsPerTile=16) — a fixed 16x16 square stable under moves — instead of unwrapMesh, with an Unwrap button to re-derive on demand (the only time it recomputes); unwrapMesh stays as the on-demand projection generator. Tests: editMesh 24/24 (+5 new: a fresh cube is unwrapped; a vertex move leaves UVs byte-identical; a cut's new corner UV equals the edge lerp; storedUVLayout is invariant under a move; re-unwrap rewrites from geometry); modelStream 4/4 regression; UVPanel + the full sources.ts chain bundle clean. Hot-reload TSX, nothing committed. Next sub-piece (still 5a): selection-scoped display (show the selected face's island), which needs the viewport's face selection lifted into the shared store; then 5b/5c/5d.
